translation.Message_0_Page_1: But I do remember the locations and what's in them. What we need most right now is food, water, and meds, and there are some crates laying around in the town Burywood.

translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Anomaly-5 is another unintended outcome arising from DNA splicing, exhibiting a formidable appearance as a gray entity adorned with prominently protruding bone wings. Distinguished by its luminous pink eyes and corresponding pink luminescence emanating from its wings, this anomaly poses a significant threat. Notably, it possesses the ability to envelop an area in dense fog, hindering visibility and impeding navigation. Furthermore, Anomaly-5 demonstrates a compelling capability for auditory mimicry, replicating the voices of individuals known to its target, evoking a siren-like allure. Remarkably, it can mimic voices of individuals beyond its expected knowledge range, amplifying the potential danger it presents. Comprehensive investigation is warranted to discern the full extent of Anomaly-5's abilities, ensuring appropriate countermeasures and safeguards are implemented to mitigate its hazardous nature.

translation.Name: Buak_Note_40
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Anomaly-4, a byproduct of DNA splicing, presents a highly perilous nature by adopting the guise of a scarecrow. Despite its seemingly immobile appearance, this anomaly possesses the ability to move, defying initial expectations. Of particular concern is its observed capability for multiplication, raising further uncertainties regarding its reproductive mechanisms. Currently, limited information is available regarding the full range of Anomaly-4's abilities. Extensive research is imperative to ascertain its complete spectrum of capabilities and to devise appropriate containment protocols, given its inherent dangers and propensity for unexpected behavior. Exercise extreme caution when handling or studying this anomaly, as underestimating its potential could lead to severe consequences.

data.Interactability_Reward_7_Text: Thank you! I thought you'd just leave me here.

data.Interactability_Reward_9_Text: It was only after some time that I realized I wasn't even moving, at all.

data.Interactability_Reward_11_Text: I'm just too lost to ever come back on my own.
data.Interactability_Reward_12_Text: The only advice I can give you is to keep your sanity protected.
data.Interactability_Reward_13_Text: Stay strong my friend, stay strong.

translation.Name: Note - Military #4
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_3: Somebody has to keep a record of what actually happened, otherwise anything can become history. We didn't know of course, it was just a few blips on the radar - could easily have been a suprise attack, and we gave them fair warning! Although in hindsite I doubt their comms use the same tech as ours. The one we recovered went down in New Mexico. The other one's lost, but I doubt there were any survivors. None of us expected it to be a flying saucer! The government's trying to play it down from the public, and the official account is that we rescued them after they crashed into an unidentified object.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_5: It's not my place to reveal any of this, and we can't change the past... The way they're handling this rubs me up the wrong way though... I think I'll quitely retire, almost at that age anyway. Maybe we'll move someplace nice.

data.Interactability_Reward_4_Text: Excellent work, champ! This concludes the first phase of your testing as an unaltered human being.
data.Interactability_Reward_5_Text: You may be confused as to why we didn’t begin by poking you with a poisoned tip or burning you with fire.
data.Interactability_Reward_6_Text: Or any other myriad of bright and colourful ways that’d probably kill you.
data.Interactability_Reward_7_Text: That’s because we know what would happen at that stage. We’d kill you. It’s all simply a placebo on our end!
data.Interactability_Reward_8_Text: What do you mean that’s not how the word is used, correct me again and you’re fired.
data.Interactability_Reward_9_Text: Anyways, After every test, you’ll come back and redo this one, as a control to see that you can still remember how to solve it.
data.Interactability_Reward_10_Text: This is to confirm that after each test your mind is unaltered since altering the mind is not one of our goals.
data.Interactability_Reward_11_Text: Please, continue to the next part of our testing regimen.
data.Interactability_Reward_13_Text: We’re actually getting somewhere here... This is seriously-... Anyways! Thank you!
data.Interactability_Reward_14_Text: You can’t imagine how much this means to me, only three more rooms to go, stranger! Go up and clear the rest of the place out, keep it up!

translation.Name: Buak_Note_19
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: During our first experiment yesterday, we experienced a critical failure. She went through the first few phases perfectly fine, but all of a sudden something went wrong, and... Rainer, Alexandra, Hannah, Elliot, Hailey all died. We need to be more careful to not create another mutation anomaly. But, with that said, our glass is half full. Maybe this happened for the best and we can learn from it. I wonder if it can feel pain, feel hurt…If it can die. If the answer to any of these questions is ‘no’, and we decisively conclude that, we’re on the right path.

data.Interactability_Reward_3_Text: Perfect! Now let's get that out of your way.
data.Interactability_Reward_4_Text: Moving on, our secondary goal with this project is to not only reverse death, but to cure it!
data.Interactability_Reward_5_Text: Prophylactic examples could be burned, bludgeoned, electrocuted, touching or otherwise consuming corrosive substances, drowning in water or said corrosive substances,
data.Interactability_Reward_6_Text: diseases, and much more. Now you ask, how would we even start with solving any of this?
data.Interactability_Reward_7_Text: Gene splicing! To dumb it down for you, we’ll be cutting up what makes you, you, and swapping some minor or major parts around until we’re golden!
data.Interactability_Reward_8_Text: While it’s risky, given there’s a chance you turn into an eldritch monster on some level for a short…or slightly not as short a moment of time, the benefits far outweigh any negatives!
data.Interactability_Reward_9_Text: Besides, what do we define an eldritch being as? I sure as hell don’t consider sprouting a couple more arms as a negative.
data.Interactability_Reward_10_Text: Oh! That reminds me, you need to sign another few papers.

translation.Interactability_Text_Line_3: The local government is definitely onto us, I got evicted yesterday! With them snooping around our lab the boss is making plans with HQ to relocate. translation.Name: Audio Tape (John Mathews #1)
translation.Description:
An audio tape diary.
Inspect To Play Audio Recording

"Alright uh, John Mathews here, It appears meteors keep hitting Buak which is very odd. In our records it shows that every 3 or 4 years, one strikes, and our disposal unit comes to clean it up… for some reason that I don’t think I’m supposed to know... I gained some interest in this subject after hearing the locals discuss it a few weeks ago, saying they’ve seen it happen on occasion. And after reading our records, I decided to keep an eye out each night for as long as I could really be bothered to do so. And then last night it happened west of the scrap yard. Long story short… It contained something quite interesting. Something that appears to be… alive. I plan to do further research on the sample I collected and find out- Oh yeah Sarah, yeah I’ll be right ther-"

translation.Name: Buak_Note_39
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Anomaly-3 is an unintended consequence of DNA splicing, resulting in a unique manifestation where the subject's skin takes on a plant-like green appearance and splits into two distinct entities. Initially appearing docile, these entities employ a deceptive strategy, luring unsuspecting individuals closer. However, upon proximity, Anomaly-3 exhibits aggressive behavior. The first entity splits its head and torso vertically, unveiling sets of sharp teeth on each side. Conversely, the second entity possesses a mouth that spans horizontally across its head, extending beyond the dimensions of a typical human mouth, which likewise exposes formidable teeth when opened. Close observation and caution are advised when handling or studying Anomaly-3, as its hostile response could pose significant risks.

translation.Name: Buak_Note_21
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: We finally did it. We dropped the ball hard enough that the other chairmen have decided to unanimously consider the bioweapon contracts due to how many times we’ve accidentally made them. I really thought they were joking, but I was wrong. They said it’s for “funding future endeavours” and that “they will never be used”, but having things like that isn’t a good idea in the first place. I suppose once our research is complete it won’t even matter- but what if we aren’t fast enough? I’ll have to think up something soon, and delay it for as long as I can.

translation.Name: Buak_Note_13
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: I made a sentient wristwatch, Boredom. Simple as that! Problem is, I factored in a miscalculation into my development, and now it’s a sentient wristwatch with a thirst for blood. We all have our quirks. Anyways, I had it on for months and the little [UNINTELLIGIBLE] developed needles that stuck into my arm and drank around half a litre of my blood over time. Couldn’t get it off for months. Apparently, it’s also a sadist, because it’s only after it sucked my blood that I realized it also wanted me to cut off my own hand. It wins this round, but I’ll be back, with a sentient hammer with a thirst for hour hands.

data.Interactability_Reward_16_Text: Welcome, test subject volunteer to Scorpion-7; The institute of tomorrow!
data.Interactability_Reward_17_Text: Is that the best they could come up with? Let’s just roll with it for now.
data.Interactability_Reward_18_Text: As you could see, the place isn’t fully operational yet, but it's operational enough for science to metamorphose into progress!
data.Interactability_Reward_19_Text: That’s where you come in, testing! Whether you’re here because of a fondness for science or for a free crisp one-hundred dollar bill, you will be taking part in forming our future.
data.Interactability_Reward_20_Text: My name is Zakery Zakerson- I am the head of this branch of Scorpion-7 here in beautiful Buak.
data.Interactability_Reward_21_Text: And here at Scorpion-7, our main goal is to reach back into the graves of our loved ones, and pull them back into the land of the living!
data.Interactability_Reward_22_Text: If it has a skeleton, it’s eligible for testing. If anything goes wrong, which is unlikely, we’ll bring you back to life too. Guaranteed. Or your dead money back.
data.Interactability_Reward_23_Text: Your being here is step one of becoming a Canadian hero! Who knows, maybe your name will be included in future textbooks or,
data.Interactability_Reward_24_Text: those outlandish word problems where people are partaking in capitalism a bit too much.
data.Interactability_Reward_25_Text: Now, if for any reason, you’ve managed to get this far, and are one of those naysayers who tout bringing the dead back to life as “Immoral” or “Illegal”,
data.Interactability_Reward_26_Text: or “Something that would anger the spirits of the underworld”
data.Interactability_Reward_27_Text: The only thing that’ll have your name on it is the exit sheet.
data.Interactability_Reward_28_Text: Please sign it and be on your way to exempting us from any liability of your untimely undoing.

translation.Name: Note - Dr. Behan #1
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_3: My new workstation at the outpost is turning out a lot better than I expected. The staff here seem to be warming up to me already, and Dr. Stevens even invited me to play chess earlier today! This lot's experiments are a step above the boring DNA splicing down South and for the first time in months I am feeling intellectually stimulated. Still, I miss Spot and the cold up here is something else, but the move was unavoidable for obvious reasons.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_5: The shipment from HQ came in earlier than expected, more contract work for those executives at Big J. This one seems to be part of an even larger project, and I get the feeling they are splitting it up between the labs to make it harder for us to see the big picture. Not really sure what the consumer application is either, but hey, it pays the bills!

translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Anomaly-1 is an unintended result of our DNA splicing experiment, transforming the subject into an extraordinary entity resembling a colossal living skeleton suspended from the ceiling. The lower body, concealed within the ceiling, remains unseen. Surrounding the creature, sharp bone protrusions emerge from the roof. Despite its apparent stillness, the extent of its abilities remains enigmatic. Caution is advised, as Anomaly-1 is considered highly hazardous, posing a significant threat should it ever break free. Further research is necessary to understand its capabilities fully.

data.Interactability_Reward_6_Text: The subject appears to be awake, so let us begin testing.
data.Interactability_Reward_7_Text: From what we now understand through yesterday’s occurrence, ‘Anomaly 7’ may be one of our most powerful WMDs to date.
data.Interactability_Reward_8_Text: So be careful and as per procedure, wear the safety gear at all times.
data.Interactability_Reward_10_Text: Ah! Hello there. My name is Dr. Dahmer, and I’m sorry to say, but I'm afraid something quite unique has befallen you... something quite unique indeed, but fear not!
data.Interactability_Reward_11_Text: My team and I are here to help you. So just sit still or you might feel a slight deadly pinch.
data.Interactability_Reward_13_Text: Zackery Zakerson speaking, In case the writing on the wall wasn’t obvious enough, we’re running out of funding across our entire network of labs.
data.Interactability_Reward_14_Text: HQ is trying to get us back up to speed by starting a few new projects, meaning, some of you might get relocated, which is a sacrifice I was willing to make democratically.
data.Interactability_Reward_15_Text: But since no one stepped up, I would like to congratulate: John Mathews, Boris Fletcher, Samir Vargas, and Nelli Vance on their new jobs in the P.E.I branch of Scorpion-7.
data.Interactability_Reward_16_Text: Pack up, your plane leaves in 6 hours.
data.Interactability_Reward_17_Text: Sir, come quick! There’s been a breach and people are- oh.
data.Interactability_Reward_19_Text: Sir, come quick! There’s been a breach and people are being slaughtered!
data.Interactability_Reward_21_Text: Awfully close there, champ! But we can’t let you leave this early.
data.Interactability_Reward_22_Text: You are the one thing stopping us from finalising our research curing death itself!
data.Interactability_Reward_23_Text: Regeneration at such rigorous levels, my boys back here have never seen anything like it, till you came around.
data.Interactability_Reward_24_Text: Now, what side of history do you want to be on, the wrong one, or the one that cured life’s biggest nemesis?
data.Interactability_Reward_25_Text: You weren’t saving me, and you aren’t saving anyone, it’s just murder with a false promise.
data.Interactability_Reward_26_Text: What do you mean, we’re close-
data.Interactability_Reward_27_Text: Look at you spewing the same rhetoric again, and again, and again. All you have to show for it is a mountain of corpses and killing machines.
data.Interactability_Reward_28_Text: And when it all goes wrong, We’ll be free and we’ll be quick to rip the flesh from your bones!
data.Interactability_Reward_30_Text: What should we do with the body sir?
data.Interactability_Reward_31_Text: There’s no point salvaging anything. Just leave it out here for the wolves, they’ll deal with it properly.
data.Interactability_Reward_32_Text: Now get back to work, I ain’t paying you to stand around.

translation.Name: Russia Note - Kilroy's Journal
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Fascinating... Once we cracked the first several symbols the rest came very easily. From what we can tell so far these etchings seem to be a recording of the tribe's history, of particular note is this large faded icon. It's composed of runes representing nighttime, whispers, a harvest and what they describe in the text as a "soulcrystal" of immense power activated by some sort of ritual. It was so powerful that even the most pure-hearted exposed would gradually be swayed to ruthless ambition. After a horrible incident the tribes were forced to unite and fracture it, each secretly encasing a piece in stone such that no one person should know the location of all the fragments. This tribe buried their part in a tomb guarded by their spirit ancestor "Anastasia". I'm interested to see if we can find this relic, however I'm sure it was purely of superstitious or traditional importance.

data.Interactability_Reward_25_Text: Attention, Scorpion-7 employees, Zackery Zakerson speaking. I’ve got some good news, and some bad news.
data.Interactability_Reward_26_Text: Good news, we made a lot of money selling our robotic arms.
data.Interactability_Reward_27_Text: Less good news, some are being used to build tanks and missiles and there’s no details on if, when, why, or where they will be used.
data.Interactability_Reward_28_Text: Got everyone a raise here though, so I don’t care as much. Not only that, but the money has helped us expand and open 25 new labs! That’s a lot of science, gentlemen!
data.Interactability_Reward_29_Text: Now for the real bad news. Some airheaded intern in some Marketing and Design department thought it’d be a good idea to standardise the containers of
data.Interactability_Reward_30_Text: rat poison and dog food, making them look awfully similar. While we don’t have dogs, we sure as hell no longer have any test subjects left in Sector 3.
data.Interactability_Reward_31_Text: At the very least, we can say with ninety-seven point five percent certainty that rat poison is still an issue within test subjects, so it’s a glass half full, half empty type situation.

data.Interactability_Reward_6_Text: I... hope so atleast I don't...
data.Interactability_Reward_7_Text: Anyway! I'm trapped in this magical death crystal thing! Atleast that's what I'd call it... I'd...

data.Interactability_Reward_10_Text: I’ve been trapped here for who knows how long, and I’m hoping that you can maybe... help free me?

translation.Name: Buak_Note_47
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_1: I hope this letter finds you in a moment of reflection and peace. It has been a trying time for all of us since Woodchuck McMill's untimely passing. It was a tragedy that the tree next to him was chopped down, unable to protect him from that lightning that struck that night. I want you to know that he held a deep affection for you, and it wasn't an easy decision to keep you from the LLL group. We both believed that your past as a lumberjack might hinder your commitment to our pacifist ideals.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2:
However, circumstances have changed. So, Timmy, have you thought about the peace treaty? The Live Laugh Love group could use someone with your strength and resilience. We've lost a guiding light, but together, we can carry on his legacy, embracing the values he held so dear.

With hope for a peaceful future,

Cowherd Camlin

translation.Name: Buak_Note_42
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Anomaly-6, an unintended outcome resulting from DNA splicing, exhibits a unique manifestation with complete paralysis of its body. However, it possesses the extraordinary ability of telepathic magnetism. To facilitate mobility, large chain-like arms have been securely affixed to its back, along with strategically embedded metallic components within its body. Notably, a notable side effect of its telepathic manipulation of metal objects is the generation of intense heat, leading to severe burns on the subject. Consequently, it is imperative to remove the chains when experimental testing involving Anomaly-6 is not in progress. Further investigation is essential to understand the precise mechanics behind its telepathic magnetism, while adopting rigorous safety measures to mitigate the risk of injury to both the subject and researchers.

data.Interactability_Reward_9_Text: With what I’m seeing out there, it’s clear the Scorpion-7 subjects weren’t the only ones to suffer.
data.Interactability_Reward_10_Text: Things really went out of control and now the world I knew is gone.
data.Interactability_Reward_11_Text: The Turned were engineered to withstand some serious brunt, and even with cities of ‘em dead, I doubt we can really win.
data.Interactability_Reward_12_Text: A part of me really thought there’s no point in trying to escape anymore... But, I remember now, I shouldn’t be the only one left to suffer in my story.
data.Interactability_Reward_13_Text: You know who really deserves to suffer?
data.Interactability_Reward_14_Text: I’ll give you a hint, they are the last one.

translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Anomaly-2 is an unintended outcome of DNA splicing, resulting in sunken eyes and a recessed mouth, while its arms have transformed into vortex-like black holes reminiscent of tornados. Intriguingly, this creature possesses the remarkable ability to transport objects within a radius of approximately 500 meters, though the precise limits regarding size and weight remain unknown. Remarkably, Anomaly-2 exhibits docile behavior and can comprehend and follow instructions, facilitating its utilization for transporting various items within the laboratory. However, it is imperative to note that when removing this anomaly from its containment, proper communication and adherence to the appropriate containment protocols are vital to ensure safety and prevent any unforeseen consequences. Further study is required to fully comprehend the extent of its transporting capabilities.

translation.Name: Buak_Note_48
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Now that the team finally pulled themselves together, I was able to get the report on what happened.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_3: After she died during one of the procedures, the orders were simple. Incinerate the body.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_4: While those slackers were grieving for that monster instead of doing their job, something happened.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_5: She resurrected, after all these years, all those experiments, all the money that went into this.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_6: All of that and she’s the one who gets to come back? What a joke.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_7: And to the team who thought they could fix her? I told you, look at you now.
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_8: I should have listened to my gut and put her down years ago.

translation.Name: Buak_Note_45
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Dear Zackery,
translation.Interactability_Text_Line_3: We are writing to formally request that you change your last name from Solace. The association with the Solace family name has become unbearable for us, as it is inextricably linked to the tragic loss of our other child. While we understand that you may not be responsible for the incident, the pain is too great for us to bear, and we can no longer see a future in which we can continue to be a family. We believe it is best for all parties involved that we go our separate ways and never cross paths again.

translation.Interactability_Text_Line_2: Our research indicates a significant divergence in vital organ functionality among the Turned gene splicing mutations. While the majority exhibit absence of heartbeat and non-functional lungs, an unexpected subset displays sporadic heartbeat and limited lung activity. These findings emphasise the complex nature of the mutations and underscore the necessity for continued research to comprehend their intricate biological nature.
